exactas.¿Alcanza la lluvia para los cultivos?: Is rainfall enough for the crops?
exactas.¿Hace demasiado calor para los cultivos?: Is it too hot for the crops?

exactas.Sin riego, el suelo tiene que guardar ag: Without irrigation, the soil has to store water between crops (fallow or residue). Drought-tolerant crops such as sorghum and wheat fit better than corn or soybeans.
exactas.Hay agua para sembrar más seguido, pero: There is water to crop more often, but dry years are still a risk.
exactas.El maíz pierde rendimiento si florece co: Corn loses yield if it flowers in that heat (July). Sorghum and sunflower tolerate it better; wheat avoids it because it is harvested in June.
exactas.No siembre maíz ni soja antes de esa fec: Do not plant corn or soybeans before that date. An April frost can damage wheat when it is heading.
exactas.Los meses de mayor riesgo son de marzo a: The riskiest months are March to May. It helps to leave standing residue or a cover crop at that time.
exactas.Dejar más rastrojo y menos meses de suel: Leaving more residue and fewer months of bare soil increases organic matter, so the soil absorbs and holds water better.
exactas.Si riega, cada año el agua estará más ho: If you irrigate, every year the water will be deeper and cost more to pump. Rotations that yield with little irrigation fit better.
exactas.El riego parece sostenible por ahora; re: Irrigation seems sustainable for now; check your water rights.
exactas.El nivel de los pozos cercanos está bast: The level of nearby wells is fairly stable.
exactas.Los cultivos con muchos años malos o muc: Crops with many bad years or a lot of unharvested acreage are the riskiest here. Diversifying the rotation spreads that risk across crops that suffer at different times.

exactas.Días de calor en mayo y junio: Hot days in May and June
exactas.Noches muy frías en abril y mayo: Very cold nights in April and May
exactas.Parte de la zona con suelos que se vuela: Share of the area with easily blown soils
exactas.Toda el agua que cae en un año (lluvia y: All the water that falls in a year (rain and snow), 1981-2025 average. 1 mm equals 1 liter per square meter.
exactas.Cantidad de agua que un cultivo bien reg: The amount of water a well-watered crop would lose in a year to sun, heat and wind. Specialists call it reference evapotranspiration (ET0).
exactas.Diferencia entre el agua que pide el amb: The difference between the water the atmosphere demands and rainfall. It is what the soil or irrigation would have to supply.
exactas.Promedio del mayor número de días seguid: Average of the longest run of days without useful rain (less than 1 mm) during the season.
exactas.Porcentaje de años en que llovió menos d: Percentage of years with less than 70% of normal rainfall.
exactas.Compara la lluvia del año con el agua qu: Compares the year's rainfall with the water a healthy crop loses to sun, heat and wind. 100% means rainfall is just enough.
exactas.Días en que la temperatura máxima llega: Days when the maximum temperature reaches 35 °C or more. In that heat many plants close their pores and stop growing.
exactas.Días con 32 °C o más cuando el trigo est: Days at 32 °C or more while wheat is filling its grain. More days mean smaller kernels.
exactas.Noches con -2 °C o menos cuando los cult: Nights at -2 °C or colder when crops are already growing or just planted.
exactas.Tiempo entre la última helada de primave: Time between the last spring frost and the first fall frost. It defines which summer crops can mature.
exactas.Fecha promedio de la última noche bajo 0: Average date of the last night below 0 °C in spring.
exactas.Fecha promedio de la primera noche bajo: Average date of the first night below 0 °C in fall.
exactas.Clasificación oficial de los suelos de E: Official US soil classification (wind erodibility group): 1 means wind carries it off very easily; 8 means it hardly blows.
exactas.Porcentaje del área con suelos de los gr: Percentage of the area with soils in groups 1 to 3.
exactas.Los suelos con mucha arena se vuelan más: Sandy soils blow more and hold less water.
exactas.Cuánto se inclina el terreno: 1% es un m: How steep the land is: 1% is one meter of drop every 100 meters. With more slope, rain carries away more soil.
exactas.Días con 25 mm de lluvia o más. Si el su: Days with 25 mm of rain or more. If the soil is bare, that water runs off and carries soil.
exactas.Restos de plantas y raíces ya descompues: Decomposed plant and root remains in the top 30 cm. It improves structure, water intake and nutrients.
exactas.Agua que el primer metro de suelo retien: Water held in the first meter of soil that roots can use. It is a reserve between rains.
exactas.Partículas muy finas que retienen agua y: Very fine particles that hold water and nutrients. A lot of clay can make soil heavy and slow to drain.
exactas.Clasificación oficial de aptitud del sue: Official land capability class: 1 and 2 have almost no limitations; 3 and 4 have limitations (climate, erosion); 5 or more, not suitable for continuous cropping.
exactas.Distancia desde la superficie hasta el a: Distance from the surface to the water at the latest measurement. More depth means more expensive pumping.
exactas.Porcentaje de pozos cercanos donde el ni: Percentage of nearby wells where the level drops more than 6 cm per year.
exactas.Porcentaje de días sin agua en la estaci: Percentage of days without water at the nearest stream gauge. It shows whether river water could be an alternative.
exactas.Parte de lo sembrado que se abandonó o s: Share of planted acreage abandoned or grazed because it was not worth harvesting (drought, hail, frost).
exactas.Cuánto subió o bajó el rendimiento cada: How much yield rose or fell every 10 years. Gains usually come from varieties and management; declines, from more drought or heat.
exactas.No está confirmado: puede ser variación: It is not confirmed: it may be year-to-year variation.
exactas.El cambio está confirmado por la estadís: The change is statistically confirmed (not chance).
exactas.Todavía no está confirmado: puede ser va: It is not confirmed yet: it may be natural year-to-year variation.

exactas.Herramienta de apoyo: los puntajes orden: A support tool: the scores rank options with the data and assumptions shown. They do not replace the farmer's judgment or a review by a local advisor (K-State Extension, NRCS).
exactas.Fechas de siembra/cosecha y variedades c: Planting/harvest dates and varieties with the extension agent.
exactas.Precios locales (elevador, feedlot) y co: Local prices (elevator, feedlot) and the grower's real costs.
exactas.Disponibilidad de equipo y mano de obra: Equipment and labor availability for the new crops.
exactas.Especies y fecha de terminación de la co: Cover crop species and termination date (NRCS can cost-share through EQIP).
exactas.El maíz en secano tiene pérdidas grandes: Dryland corn has large losses in dry years (very variable yield).
exactas.La cobertura consume agua: en años secos: The cover crop uses water: in dry years it can lower the next crop's yield. Terminate it early.
exactas.Deja nitrógeno en el suelo (soja, alfalf: Leaves nitrogen in the soil (soybeans, alfalfa or vetch): less fertilizer is bought for the next crop.
exactas.Mantiene el suelo cubierto en primavera,: Keeps the soil covered in spring, when the wind blows hardest.
exactas.Tiene cultivos de raíz profunda que usan: Has deep-rooted crops that use water from below and open paths for rain to soak in.
exactas.Usa cultivos que aguantan bien la sequía: Uses crops that handle drought and heat well.
exactas.Cambia de cultivo de un año a otro: cort: Changes crops from one year to the next: breaks pests, weeds and diseases.
exactas.Produce forraje: ingreso extra si tiene: Produces forage: extra income if you have livestock or a feedlot nearby.
exactas.Resultados muy parecidos a lo que hace h: Results very similar to what you do today.
exactas.Ninguna rotación cumple las restriccione: No rotation meets the stated constraints.
exactas.Evapotranspiración (ET): agua que sale d: Evapotranspiration (ET): water that leaves the field through soil evaporation plus plant transpiration. Reference ET (ET0) is what well-watered grass would use under the day's weather; a crop uses ET0 x Kc (crop coefficient). If rain plus soil water do not cover that use, the crop suffers and yields less.
exactas.Balance hídrico: lluvia menos ET0. Un dé: Water balance: rainfall minus ET0. A large, persistent deficit means dryland fields benefit from fallow or tolerant crops (sorghum, wheat) and that irrigation depends on the aquifer.
exactas.NDVI: índice de verdor calculado con luz: NDVI: greenness index calculated from red and infrared light (Landsat). Bare soil ~0.1-0.2, crop in full growth 0.6-0.9. It shows when the field is bare and when the crop is stressed.
exactas.Riesgo de heladas: frecuencia de noches: Frost risk: frequency of nights below 0 °C (or -2 °C) in sensitive months. A late April frost damages heading wheat; one in May may force replanting corn or soybeans.
exactas.Anomalía de humedad del suelo: cuánto se: Soil moisture anomaly: how far a month's moisture is from its historical average, in standard deviations. -1 or less is a clearly drier-than-normal month.
exactas.Tendencia: pendiente de Sen (cambio típi: Trend: Sen's slope (typical change per decade, robust to unusual years) with a Mann-Kendall test. 'Significant' (p<0.05) means the change is unlikely to be chance.
exactas.Incertidumbre: cada rotación se simula 3: Uncertainty: each rotation is simulated 300 times with different climate years from the 1981-2025 record, varied prices and agronomic parameters, and perturbed priority weights. The p10-p90 range shows where the score falls 8 times out of 10; 'probability of being best' is the share of simulations in which that rotation came first. Overlapping ranges = inconclusive difference.
exactas.Leguminosas (soja, alfalfa, vicia) fijan: Legumes (soybeans, alfalfa, vetch) fix nitrogen from the air with bacteria in their roots; part of it remains for the next crop and reduces fertilizer.
exactas.Cultivos de cobertura: protegen el suelo: Cover crops: protect the soil when there is no cash crop, curb wind and water erosion and add organic matter. In a dry climate they use water the next crop will not have.
exactas.Cultivos de raíz profunda (girasol, alfa: Deep-rooted crops (sunflower, alfalfa, sorghum) draw water and nutrients from deep layers and leave channels that improve infiltration.
exactas.Cultivos tolerantes a sequía y calor (so: Drought- and heat-tolerant crops (sorghum, wheat, sunflower) lose less yield per unit of water deficit (lower Ky) than corn.
exactas.Observación satelital: mide desde el esp: Satellite observation: measures a surface property from space (reflectance, temperature, microwaves). It covers the whole field evenly, but depends on clouds, pixel resolution and models to turn the signal into the agronomic variable.
exactas.Modelo/reanálisis (NASA POWER-MERRA-2):: Model/reanalysis (NASA POWER-MERRA-2): combines satellites, stations and a physical model on a ~50 km grid. It is continuous and long (1981-today) but smooths local differences: a storm may not show up.
exactas.Medición en terreno: pozos, estaciones d: Ground measurement: wells, stream gauges or soil surveys. It is precise at the measured point but does not always represent the neighboring field.
exactas.Estadística agrícola (USDA NASS): promed: Agricultural statistics (USDA NASS): average of yields reported in the county; it is not your field.
exactas.Cálculo de esta herramienta a partir de: Calculated by this tool from the data above (FAO formulas and editable assumptions).
exactas.Los satélites (Landsat, SMAP, ECOSTRESS,: Satellites (Landsat, SMAP, ECOSTRESS, GPM, GRACE) see large areas repeatedly and uniformly, but they measure indirect signals with limitations: SMAP only measures the top ~5 cm of soil in 9 km pixels; GRACE detects water changes in ~300 km cells; Landsat cannot see through clouds and passes every 8-16 days. Ground measurements (USGS wells, stream gauges, SSURGO soil profiles) are exact where they are taken but are single points. Combining them improves accuracy: the satellite provides the spatial and temporal pattern and the ground calibrates it. That is why this tool uses USGS wells for the Ogallala aquifer (GRACE is too coarse for a field) and POWER/IMERG for climate, and warns when a source is missing.
exactas.USDA NASS QuickStats, Kansas 1981-2026:: USDA NASS QuickStats, Kansas 1981-2026: yields and planted and harvested acreage by county; weekly crop condition, soil moisture and planting/harvest progress reported by farmers and extension staff; prices received. These are ground measurements and surveys, not estimates made by this tool.
exactas.USDA NASS \"Crop Sequence Boundaries\":: USDA NASS "Crop Sequence Boundaries": each field's boundary and its crop for each year 2017-2024, derived from satellite imagery. If the service does not respond, OpenStreetMap fields are used, without history. A circular shape suggests center-pivot irrigation but does not confirm it.
exactas.Un futuro posible del clima, armado trim: A possible future climate, built quarter by quarter from how dry, normal and wet quarters followed one another between 1981 and 2025.
exactas.Rendimiento promedio en el 20 % de los e: Average yield in the 20 % least favorable scenarios. It measures how badly a rotation would do when the weather does not cooperate.
exactas.Búsqueda matemática de la mejor combinac: Mathematical search for the best combination of crops for 2027, 2028 and 2029 that respects available water, does not repeat a crop two years in a row and limits the years of corn.
exactas.Busca el mayor rendimiento promedio, sin: Seeks the highest average yield, without paying special attention to bad years.
exactas.Da el mismo peso al rendimiento promedio: Gives equal weight to average yield and to protection against bad years.
exactas.Prioriza que los años malos sean lo meno: Prioritizes making bad years as mild as possible, even if the average drops a little.
exactas.Incluye maíz, que en los registros de Fi: Includes corn, which in Finney's records is the most stable crop from year to year (it is usually irrigated), but the one that needs the most water.
exactas.El sorgo pide menos agua y aguanta la se: Sorghum needs less water and tolerates drought; that is why it helps stay within the water budget.
exactas.El trigo crece en otoño-invierno-primave: Wheat grows in fall-winter-spring and spreads the risk with summer crops.
exactas.La lluvia de un trimestre anticipa muy p: One quarter's rainfall says very little about the next.
exactas.Son valores ilustrativos del modelo y de: These are illustrative model values and should be replaced with verified agronomic data.
exactas.Los costos son supuestos editables; los: Costs are editable assumptions; prices are the average received in Kansas over the last 3 marketing years (USDA NASS), not today's price.
exactas.No hay datos de manejo del lote (histori: There is no field management data (history, fertilization, weeds, equipment).
exactas.POWER tiene resolución ~50 km: no distin: POWER has ~50 km resolution: it cannot tell ridges from low spots within the field.
exactas.El escenario de clima escala lluvia y te: The climate scenario scales rainfall and temperature but does not change storm frequency or wind.
exactas.El campo seleccionado parece tener riego: The selected field appears to have center-pivot irrigation; moderate irrigation was selected. Change it if that is not right.
exactas.Sin serie GRACE local (data/grace/grace_: No local GRACE series (data/grace/grace_tws.csv). USGS wells are used as a direct measurement of the aquifer.
exactas.Sin archivo OpenET local (opcional; requ: No local OpenET file (optional; requires an openetdata.org key)

exactas.Por eso el modelo no da un solo pronósti: That is why the model does not give a single forecast: it simulates 300 possible futures and picks rotations that work well in most of them.

The model simulates {1} possible futures of Finney County's climate and estimates how much each crop would yield in each one. It then searches for the wheat, sorghum and corn rotation that best fits the chosen strategy without exceeding the available water. It is calculated for the whole county (NASA point {2}° N, {3}° W), not for the selected field.

"Agua que necesita un cultivo" es el # % de la demanda del ambiente para un cultivo en crecimiento. "Años con helada" es el porcentaje de años con al menos una noche bajo # °C en ese mes. De marzo a mayo el viento es más fuerte: no conviene dejar el suelo desnudo.

"Water a crop needs" is {1} % of atmospheric demand for a growing crop. "Years with frost" is the percentage of years with at least one night below {2} °C that month. From March to May the wind is strongest: avoid leaving the soil bare.

Bien = sin problemas destacados. Aten. (atención) = un problema en ese mes (falta de agua, calor durante la floración o helada). Probl. (problema) = falta mucha agua o se juntan dos problemas. Pase el cursor sobre una celda para ver el motivo.

Good = no notable problems. Caution = one problem that month (water shortage, heat during flowering or frost). Problem = severe water shortage or two problems together. Hover over a cell to see the reason.
